package.name: lockwire_ros
package.description: The lockwire preflight gate as a ROS 2 lifecycle node. Refuses to configure when the powered-on robot disagrees with its checked-in physics lockfile. Deliberately depends on nothing outside ros_core: the lockwire core is invoked out of process, so this package runs on whatever Python its distro ships — Humble (3.10) included, which an in-process import could never do.
